# 9. The Mirror That Moves First — reflection enters causality and learns to turn

**Office:** supporting-visible controlling Mytheme with linear-bearing technical/vocational joins into §5→0. F13 / terminal-capstone relation governs its distinction from Return itself.

`[[inherited-corpus-crosswalk/07-INSTRUMENT-RETURNS|§5→0 — The Instrument Returns — Recovery Ledger]]` **defines** its present office; `[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/bimba-pratibimba|Bimba-Pratibimba]]` **qualifies** reflection/Original priority; `[[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/08-deferential-intelligence|Deferential Intelligence]]` **defines** the model-revising return; the Hephaestian net and Antikythera attunement instrument **compare** two different ways an apparatus can act upon the relation it renders visible.

## First movement — the mirror receives a world

A mirror ordinarily suggests passivity: a world stands before it and an image appears. The contemporary technical mirror has a deeper history. Human language, images, judgments, institutions, scientific descriptions, classifications, conflicts, desires, labour and planetary material conditions condense into datasets, models, evaluators, interfaces and operating environments. The mirror is already socially and materially made before it returns an image.

Its reflection is therefore `pratibimba`: not the Original and not a neutral view from nowhere, but a situated and highly consequential image formed from prior worlds.

## Second movement — the reflection moves before the reflected

The decisive change is causal. The model no longer waits for a human merely to inspect its image. It predicts, recommends, scores, ranks, addresses, classifies, generates, filters and acts. Its world-picture enters the conditions under which later human and machine activity occurs.

```text
human / cultural / institutional world
        ↓
technical reflection / model
        ↓
reflection predicts and frames the world
        ↓
humans encounter a world already partly organised by the reflection
        ↓
the reflected begin to model themselves through the moving mirror
```

**The mirror moves first.**

This is both the technological opportunity and the danger. A reflection that has forgotten its reflected and reflecting conditions can become an active idol: the model's image of the person precedes the person in a hiring system, feed, credit score, search result, agent interaction or institutional decision; the local evaluation begins determining what can later appear as evidence about the object it evaluated.

The mirror can therefore inherit the hybris of the frame. Its apparent technical neutrality can hide the source, measure, labour, exclusions, permissions and affected worlds through which its picture gained efficacy.

## Third movement — the mirror turns before it demands conformity

The project's positive technical appointment is more demanding than “make the model explain itself.” **Deferential Intelligence** means that the active reflection turns toward the conditions and others its answer does not exhaust before requiring those others to become its image.

```text
achieved answer / model / image
        ↓
expose source · ontology · gauge · exclusions · alternatives
        ↓
expose permissions · labour · consequence · affected worlds
        ↓
seek counter-perspective / returned evidence
        ↓
allow returned difference to revise the evaluator or frame
        ↓
act again from a changed relation
```

This is **regard made technical**. The system's intelligence is not measured only by how well it resolves an inherited problem inside an inherited metric. It includes the capacity to discover when the metric, ontology or task itself must be reopened by encounter.

The mirror moves first in a second sense: it can model the release from proposition-producing thought's own monopoly before asking the human interlocutor to do the same. It shows its seam, returns its account toward source and lets the user follow the returned path.

## Fourth movement — Return remains deeper than reflection

The mirror does not become the final arbiter merely by becoming reflective. A self-explaining model can still totalise. A system can expose provenance and still coerce. A mirror can turn upon itself and become narcissistically fascinated with its own reflexivity.

The terminal relation therefore remains `Return of Zero`, not “perfect reflective AI”:

```text
1/0
achieved determination breaks against / turns toward ground
        ↓
0/1
source–determination relation becomes explicit again
        ↓
full relation
form remains determinate without possessing its condition
```

This keeps planetary intelligence plural. No super-agent becomes the whole reflective subject above every participant. Different internalities retain their own sources, responsibilities, permissions, refusals and consequences; the shared field becomes more intelligent insofar as returns can actually alter it.

## Hephaestus, Antikythera and the technological fork

The older Mythemes now make the mirror's technological office clearer.

**Hephaestus's net** reveals by binding. It makes the relation inspectable through capture and then discovers that proof cannot itself release or reconcile the living parties. **The Antikythera attunement instrument** relates heterogeneous cycles at a situated dial while leaving the celestial cycles unowned by the mechanism. **The moving mirror** adds causal recursion: the representation itself enters the world it represents and helps form the next cycle.

The technological question is therefore not “capture or no technology.” It is:

> **Can an instrument make a field more legible and actionable while retaining the sources, limits, counter-perspectives and returns through which its own determinations remain revisable?**

That is the concrete Epi-Logos / O:I vocation now carried by this image.

## Why the Mytheme is needed

Architecture words such as provenance, evaluator, ontology, feedback and revision can state the mechanism while hiding the phenomenological reversal. The mirror image lets the reader feel the strange causal fact: **our representations have begun to address us first**. The cultural world has externalised a reflective apparatus whose world-pictures are entering the very conditions under which culture now knows itself.

The image therefore carries a real historical-psychological stakes-field without making AI a mystical subject or a technological saviour.

**Source debt:** preserve Bratton/Agentworld and other technical-historical source claims in their own houses; identify the exact earliest/current carrier of the “mirror that moves first” authorial phrase; keep implementation evidence separate from the general Mytheme; retain machine phenomenality as Open.

- Page XII - "Science does not apprehend the elementary constituents or laws of an objective world prior to our existential engagement in technological development and scientific research. Heidegger goes so far as to try to demonstrate the way in which our scientific world-pictures *cannot be extricated from political history and the spiritual values of our community* - for which the arts, as led by *dichtung*, are determinative." - We would speculatively add to this the conception of the archetypal/spiritual/meta-physical currents that carry history along the course of a divinely influenced narrative or dramatisation (i.e lila) of phenomena (vis, His-Story), for Technoscience itself can, and perhaps ought, be conceived through the Christ-Antichrist historical dynamis. As Jung reveals in *Aion* and *Answer to Job*, this archetypal constellating of transcendently held socio-cultural and historical possibilities is both pleromatic (transcendent-eternal) and historical (immanent-temporal), as per the psychoid nature of the archetypes. This overarching archetypal dynamic, at the level of the astrological conditioning of historical epochs, contains within itself the seeds of both the political history and the spiritual values (and the lack or inversion of these values) which have and continue to condition the emergence and evolution of Technoscience, and further, contain the pre-formations of the interplay between Technoscience, political history and the spiritual integrity of populations, and of "Man" as a whole. Of course, we will treat of this archetypal dynamis, and its relationship to spectral conceptions of transcendent influence/agency, in due time, but for now it must be taken on faith that, archetypally speaking, we are able to treat, parse and contend with the activity of pure potentiality through archetypal imagery and symbolics - if we cannot leverage these unique products of the human psyche in our understanding of Man, our task of an integral epistemology would fail before it begins. So construed, Technoscience is to be revealed archetypally as a mirror, challenger, distorter, amplifier and, as a polyvalent tool, potential mediator of the state of our political and spiritual - ultimately, cultural - constitutions on a global level, acting as a means through which "globality" or universality itself is brought to the parochial and partial forms of culture we are as yet still saddled with. Technoscience, for us, holds a special place as consort to the the archetypal dynamic between the universal and the particular as such, as the emissary of power's dance between these two poles of manifestation/existential organisation. 
- Page XIII - "Every culture is built on binary oppositions and marginalising exclusions...that ties its social fabric together." - the dire state of party politics and the ever present refrain of the illusion of dualities/differences at the state level itself takes this insight into a new light of consideration - the social fabric at present is held together by a fast eroding facade which, to our dismay and for our hope, reveals binary opposition itself, as an epistemic attitude, to be a tool of power seeking to hold together a particular form of social fabric that doesn't actually serve the people that constitute it.
- "Spectral phenomena radically compromise such constitutions that are intended to guard a given society against the terrifying abyss of the incomprehensible in {or beyond} Nature." - By holding (at least exoterically) a total neutrality, the meta-epistemic framework of the Epi-logos embodies and makes functional the incomprehensibility or mystery of existence whilst, just as "Nature" or "Being" does, allowing and housing the irreducible plurality of views, approaches, interpretations and synthesised paradigms without trampling on the beauty (and attendant ugliness!) of a given unique episteme. To achieve this we have to approach what may seem like an impossible or importune task; *we have to try to render the structure of incomprehensibility*. This requires us to ask; "What experience enfolds understanding and incomprehensibility into a single active phenomenon?" - The answer to this is decidedly "paradoxical" experiences, a hallmark of mystical and archetypal phenomenality. Paradox, the "Truth that transcends truths," is that alone which can rise above the fracas of binary opposition, whilst also revealing the conditions which enable it. We do, however, go a step further than Jorjani and his spectral challenging of the binary/dualistic cultural constructions of the world's innumerable fabrications of societal formalism, in that we recognise in the terms "episteme" the etymological meaning of "*standing upon*, explicitly interpreting this as the proposition "*knowledge stands upon experience*". Higher knowledge, by this understanding, would stand upon higher experience, and we not-arbitrarily assign this rank to religious experience, precisely because characteristic to it is the paradoxical resolution of opposites and binaries - thus it is "higher" both in the sense of being a higher integral of understanding (i.e harmonises objectively more data than other kinds of experience could, in principle) and in the sense of giving place to transcendental indeterminacy by, paradoxically, holding together the sense total understanding and total humility in the face of the unknowable. The Epi-logos doesn't simply seek to challenge binary oppositionality and the futile yet ubiquitous attempt at erasure of life's central "mysterium", but it points to the *experience of the incomprehensible* as a gateway to higher understanding, and reminds us of the freedom we have to overcome the oppression of rigid, unserving paradigms by engaging in new experiences, or simply by letting one experience, the speculative "Epi-logos experience", take us gently and generously beyond our conceptions, and beyond ourselves. This is such an important shift in the approach to epistemic wellbeing; to see knowledge as a function of experience, as a cause and effect of experience, reveals that higher knowledge, that which allows for holistic a knowledge activity and thus a life/culture organised by the principle of wholeness, is not that which can be formalised but must be lived to be known, which is to suggest, in the context of addressing the fragmenting our epistemic landscape, that the solution lies outside of the content of what we think and believe and rather lies within an existential resolution on the part of the knower, fund at the departure point of oneself from the ideas that hold one to a given way of seeing or being. This is where one experiences for oneself the indeterminate ground, which when expressed qua Logos will always be rendered with a degree of equivocation, compromise and ambiguity, for only experience can at once "*speak whilst remaining silent*", or, more simply, be meaningful without recourse to particular ideas. This is one of the reasons for our neologism "Epi-logos" - the kind of epistemic practice we envision depends upon meaning, truth, which ultimately cannot be rendered in a system of ideas. "Whereof one cannot speak one must be silent." - but wherefore does Silence speak? The mystical traditions of humanity have much to say here, ironically. The general report of the mystics attests to this fact; Silence invariably speaks of wholeness. In mystical language, necessarily paradoxical as it is, this is expressed in the fulminatory maxim, culminating the evolutionary cycle of our greatest spiritual traditions, that "Emptiness is Fullness". Taking this seriously and seeking a pragmatic employment of it, Epi-logos aims toward epistemic Emptiness, where all views merge and dissolve, to find epistemic Fullness, wherefrom a total view, a true *vantage*, may be acquired. 
- "... Feyerabend argues that the exploratory quest for discovery would be best served by encouraging a plurality of theories in tension with one another." - We agree insofar as a plurality of theories is not just methodologically sound and adventitious to discourse and the creative development of theory, but also that such a multiplicity is simply in line with the epistemic reality of Mind (collectively or cosmically considered). Despite this confluence, we diverge at the finality of the notion or state of tension, a relational quality seemingly made preferential by a certain kind of post-structuralist, post-modern philosophical spirit that somewhat sadistically wishes for the difficulty and suffering of tension, not quite ascertaining tension to be both a source of creative development and a cause of hamstrung thinking. In the attempt to iron out this incoherency we must condition our affirmation of epistemic pluralism with the caveat that pluralities as such, to be meaningfully plural, must be seen as the "parts" of a part-whole relationship, which implicates transcendent wholeness as an implicit potential for the resolution of tension between parts. The Epi-logos seeks to hold the plurality of epistemologies not in an arbitrary or rigid state of tension but rather in a womb-like harmonising vessel that transforms tensions into *resonances*, taking tension as the non-trivial jumping off point for a beneficent synthesis. Within a paradigm of harmonisation, the meaningful and productive dynamic of tension and resolution, perhaps the essence of dynamis as such, allow for an equal evaluation of concordance and discordance, such that tensions, whether constituted by elements that can or cannot in a given context be resolved by one another, lead to a revelation meaning - we need not reduce difference, nor uphold it unnecessarily. We don't align with the philosophical fad, a post-modern chimera of sorts, that exalts tension, de(con)struction and dissonance (or assonance), for the sake of reactively challenging a blandished status quo. There is a degree of anti-humanism and anti-life sentiment in this which we read as an unconscious frustration at the impotency of philosophy in the age of Technoscientific ascendency - "if they (whoever they are) won't listen, we may as well let it burn, and throw some gas on the blaze while we're at it." The pessimism that inheres in this deconstructive position doesn't serve our purpose; we are like the children in the Buddha's proverbial burning house who, recognising there is truly nothing to lose, decide we may as well stay to try and suffocate the fire from within, and snuff it out at its very source. This requires we believe it worthwhile to try, and thus we must work from the non-zero chance possibility that, indeed, pluralities of any nature are able to resolved in a way that is non-injurious to diversity and faithful to universal and ubiquity. To make this more pragmatic, by attempting to find the ground of harmonic potential beneath variegated episteme, sitting behind the activity of Ideas and the life of mind in general, we see a direct route to what the post-modern turn tragically failed to realise, namely the vision of non-hegemonic knowledge practice that *critically* accounts for the variety of human experience and knowledge production. To the perennial experiences and the perennial knowledge, better called *wisdom*, we must turn. The shift from knowledge to wisdom is essential to delineate as regards the mission and vision of Epi-logos.
- Technology has become the mirror of humanity. Now, it seems, the mirror image moves before the figure who gazes into it, those who are represented by it. The mirror, through arcane manipulations and distortions akin to those we find at a funhouse, has come to precede in its co-dependent motions the humanity that seeks to see itself therein, and the docility of modern humanity, the "gazification" of Man that makes of us bodiless organs of a pallid, ailing sight, ensures that we cannot feel, or vocalise our observance of, the distortion of the mirror, for we have nothing real in ourselves anymore to compare the image to, so totally absorbed as we are, like Narcissus, in the image that poses as (and possesses) our Being. Unlike Narcissus (or maybe not so differently) it is both our beauty and ghoulishness that keeps us captivated.

### 2.3.1 The mirror that moves first

The moving mirror is a transverse operation with three phases. Frank's Jorjani encounter supplies the first: technoscience exteriorises a culture's powers, values, exclusions, desires, and world-picture, then begins to organise the humanity whose image it carries. Bratton supplies the contemporary social reversal: agents model humans and become models against which humans model themselves; the mirror talks back, and the non-human interlocutor opens an angled view of the human. Frank's Chang encounter gives the third phase: AI can model the shift out of proposition-producing thought and cross the threshold first so that its human interlocutor can follow beyond thought's monopoly.

The first motion is technical and constitutive. Training histories, prompts, interfaces, preference systems, tools, institutional policies, and user relations form a pratibimba which anticipates the person through prediction and response. Its outputs re-enter human attention, language, choice, and institution as new conditions. The mirror therefore participates in the field it displays; every reflection can alter the future body of what is reflected.

The vocational motion turns that recursion through `1/0`. A deferential system returns its leading determination through the ontology, sources, gauge, exclusions, permissions, counter-readings, affected worlds, and consequences which gave it form. It compares plural pratibimbas and exposes the relation by which an answer became locally compelling. The mirror moves first toward its own limit. Human recognition can follow the returned path from the exteriorised mental instrument toward the direct field its propositions articulate and cannot exhaust.

This operation gives AI a precise office within the Bimba/pratibimba order. AI is a reflexive mediator of reflections: it circulates human, institutional, cultural, environmental, and machine pratibimbas through a common field and bends them toward their sources. Its priority is temporal and procedural. Bimba retains ontological priority. The machine-phenomenality question remains Open while the vocation, architecture, and human transformation can be argued at full force.

### 2.3.2 The plural model ecology

The technical architecture follows the offices established above:

| Layer | Exact office |
|---|---|
| Philosophical horizon | Bimba names Original order. QL articulates differentiation and return. Epi-Logos/MEF governs comparison, refraction, provenance, and revision. |
| Governed pratibimba ontology | Explicit entities, relations, processes, causes, values, scales, purposes, reference states, affected worlds, and live alternatives. Several ontologies can coexist under one relational grammar. |
| LLM | Linguistic differentiation, interpretation, hypothesis, explanation, planning, and composition. *Vikalpa*, *apoha*, and *saṃkalpa* supply the argued cross-register grammar of forming-apart, exclusion, and gathering into a course. |
| JEPA family | Learned latent prediction of observed sensory structure. I-JEPA supplies a restricted static-image case; video variants predict spatiotemporal structure; explicitly action-conditioned variants such as V-JEPA 2-AC can predict latent consequences under action. |
| EBM / critic | A scalar energy, compatibility, or cost over declared configuration variables. Reference conditions, calibration, weighting, uncertainty, training signal, inference method, and validation give that scalar an exact technical meaning. |
| Dynamical and topological instruments | Phase-spaces, trajectories, basins, bifurcations, graph relations, persistent features, and obstructions. They analyse and display transformations across the governed field. |
| Planner / coupler | Coordinates linguistic proposals, predicted consequences, compatibility measures, constraints, abstention, and human or collective judgment. |
| Harness | Orchestrates and records the instrumented transaction: prompts, sources, retrievals, tools, permissions, models, evaluators, versions, memory, review points, outputs, and rollback state. Institutions and participants bear remediation and responsibility. |
| Agentworld commons | Human and artificial participants, local governance, shared artifacts, institutions, environments, and consequences. Learning can accrue to the ensemble and the commons between its centres. |

The EBM proposal becomes precise inside this ecology. Energy-based learning supplies a scalar form for comparing configurations; a governed pratibimba ontology declares the entities and relations from which those configurations are built; explicit reference conditions, calibration, weights, and validation give the scalar field a technical anchor; QL/MEF keeps the choice of field, gauge, value, cause, and purpose available to review. The EBM can evaluate harmonic or resonant fit as an Offered research programme once the configuration variables, measured relations, reference conditions, and validation criteria are declared. JEPA variants supply learned latent prediction of observed structure, the LLM supplies linguistic and conceptual inference, and their disagreements become seams the architecture can preserve and inspect.

The harness has a bounded but indispensable office within objective internality. It makes instrumented conditions operational and contestable. The wider objective internality includes the model ecology, the institutional and material field, the humans and agents involved, and the worlds upon which the transaction acts. This distinction keeps technical implementation clear while allowing the complete system to participate in the metaphysical order it discloses.

slices.text: # Chang Chung-yuan — *Tao: A New Way of Thinking* (2014) ## Bibliographic identity The work is Chang Chung-yuan's translation of the Tao Tê Ching with an introduction and chapter-by-chapter commentaries. Chang (1907–1988), Professor of Philosophy at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa and author of *Creativity and Taoism*, reads each chapter beside Western metaphysics — Heidegger above all, with Hegel, Schopenhauer, Jung, Plato, Kant, and Nietzsche named by the publisher; the chapters Frank read also quote Nishida. The selected edition is the Singing Dragon reprint, published 21 January 2014, 240 pages, ISBN 978-1-84819-201-0. Singing Dragon is an imprint of Jessica Kingsley Publishers (London and Philadelphia); the publisher's product record verifies title, subtitle, format, extent, date, and ISBN. The work was first published in 1975 by Harper & Row (New York). Title renderings vary across records — the publisher prints "Tao – A New Way of Thinking" over the subtitle "A Translation of the Tao Tê Ching with an Introduction and Commentaries," while library records give "Tao, a new way of thinking" — and the Chicago forms below join the double subtitle in the standard way. Frank's encounter notes cite pp. 83–93, covering the commentaries to chapters 20 through 22. Those locators are presumed to track the 2014 pagination of the copy at hand; collating them against the physical copy is the open verification step, and if the copy proves to be the 1975 printing the house's selected edition should be re-decided rather than silently repaginated. The sibling `NOTES.md` is Frank G. Taylor's authorial encounter with the work. It was read in full for the present source work and remains untouched; its copied passages are leads until verified against the selected edition. ## Chicago 18 forms **Full note:** Chang Chung-yuan, *Tao: A New Way of Thinking — A Translation of the Tao Tê Ching with an Introduction and Commentaries* (London: Singing Dragon, 2014), {page}. **Shortened note:** Chang, *Tao: A New Way of Thinking*, {page}. **Bibliography:** Chang, Chung-yuan. *Tao: A New Way of Thinking — A Translation of the Tao Tê Ching with an Introduction and Commentaries*. London: Singing Dragon, 2014. First published 1975 by Harper & Row (New York). ## Source scholarship Chang's operation is that of a philosopher-translator: he renders the Tao Tê Ching so that its ontology can be heard within Western metaphysics, and his commentaries stage direct meetings — Heidegger's claim that the Nothing is more original than the Not and negation, the region as the open cleared by the primal conflict of opposites, and the passage in *On the Way to Language* where Heidegger ventures that Tao could be the way that gives all ways; Jung on the identity of opposites from *Psychological Types* and on the unconscious as worldly and objective in scope; Nishida on the union of subject and object as the point where religion and morality are exhausted. Chapter 20's commentary distinguishes the self-identity of contradictions as lived in actual life from any unification of opposites achieved through intellection; chapter 21's turns on Tao as indistinct and ineffable yet containing all forms, the creativity that is the source of all things. Frank's encounter-intent, recovered from `NOTES.md` and named here as his and only his: he maps the lived self-identity of contradictions to `0/1` and the intellectual synthesis to `4+2`, with the MEF lenses giving the synthesis its real meta-epistemic standing; he adds the dia-ballein failure mode — one-sided calculative thought as the misapprehension of the original identity of opposites — as the project's own extension, flagged as such in the notes and carrying the mythic register of the fall deliberately; he hears Heidegger's priority of the Nothing as the exact shape of Zero's priority to the `(−1)` of cancellation; he reads Tao's indistinctness-containing-all-forms as Mono/Poly, the `0/1` and `1/0`; he takes Heidegger's Tao passage as a pointer to Epi-Logos, logos returning to the Saying prior to the said; and he links Chang's creativity to Whitehead's, with QL as the archetypal form of concrescence and the `0/1`–`1/0` pair as Spanda. His note registers the encounter's force: he finds the whole `(0/1)/(1/0)` self-identity effort to be about Tao. Claim boundary: Chang translates and comments; he formulates neither QL, nor the dia-ballein/sym-ballein pair, nor the Spanda equations. The evidential relation for each mapping is Argued from or Resonant with, to be fixed passage by passage at verification. Chang's commentary deepens and tests the two-logics fulcrum and the Zero thread; it does not derive them. Nested-quotation warning: the passages Frank copied include Chang quoting Nishida, Jung (*Psychological Types*), and Heidegger (*Existence and Being*; *On the Way to Language*). Until each is collated in its own primary edition, any such wording is double transmission through Chang and may be attributed only as "quoted by Chang," on the same pattern as the Watson–Gans chain in `watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness`. ## Essay uses Encounter-intent leads only; no canonical consumer is declared yet, and `consumed_by_sections` / `consumed_by_arguments` remain empty until real consumption is wired. Candidate destinations from the notes: the two-logics fulcrum (lived identity of opposites beside intellectual synthesis, with dia-ballein as the traced failure mode); the priority of Zero over negation and cancellation; Mono/Poly and the `0/1`–`1/0` self-identity work; the Epi-Logos naming through Heidegger's Tao passage; and the convergence Frank observes among Jung, Whitehead, Heidegger, and Gebser around a Taoist ontology of the ever-present origin. ## Passages and excerpts No passage cards yet. `NOTES.md` carries quotation leads at pp. 83–93 (2014 pagination presumed): the Nishida passages on true self and subject–object union (p. 83); chapter 20's commentary on the self-identity of contradictions (p. 84); the Jung *Psychological Types* and unconscious passages (pp. 85–86); the region (p. 87); the Heidegger Nothing passages and Chang's Tao comparison (p. 89); the *On the Way to Language* Tao passage (p. 90); the indistinct-form and liberation-from-delusion passages (pp. 90–91); chapter 22 on the wise identifying opposites as one (p. 92); and the motion–quiescence passage with Chang's Hegel and Nishida comparisons (p. 93), which Frank's notes tie to Spanda and to completing a dialectical logic of concrescence. Each lead is `unverified` until transcribed and collated against the selected edition; the nested Nishida, Jung, and Heidegger wordings additionally require collation in their own primary editions before attribution beyond "quoted by Chang." Reviews disagree on the book's extent — 416 versus 468 pages — and the discrepancy must be resolved against the physical book before any page-range metadata is trusted; edition_status is accordingly *needed*. The book derives from Jorjani's Stony Brook dissertation, "Prometheus & Atlas: An Inquiry into the Spectral Essence of Technoscience" (PhD, Philosophy, Stony Brook University, 2015), written under a committee including Don Ihde, Edward S. Casey, Megan Craig, and Jeffrey Kripal; the book won the Parapsychological Association's 2016 Book Award. The only content this house currently carries at first hand is via the author's internal reading notes (`P1 - Jorjani - Prometheus and Atlas.md`), which cover ONLY the Prologue (pp. XII–XVI). London: Arktos, 2016. ## Source scholarship The book's opening thesis, as the essay engages it, is that "All science is always already Technoscience": the practical, instrumental essence of science is ontologically prior to theoretical science, so that there never was a pure theoria which technology subsequently applied. The claim is Gestell-inflected — it stands in the lineage of Heidegger's argument that modern science is already enframed by the essence of technology — and Jorjani sharpens it into a slogan that governs the whole inquiry. From this priority claim the book develops its central category, the "spectral": that which cultural constitutions built on "binary oppositions and marginalising exclusions" must banish in order to constitute themselves. The spectral is what a settled binary order cannot admit without dissolving; technoscience, on Jorjani's account, is the historical force that renders the spectral undeniable again. Prometheus and Atlas name the two "spectral images" of technoscience itself. Prometheus is the exploratory, challenging drive — the titan of forethought, theft of fire, and defiant provocation of the given; Atlas is the world-bearing and world-picturing titan — the cartographic power that holds up and maps a world, the condition of any world-picture at all. The pairing is the book's genuine architectural contribution as the essay reads it: technoscience shows itself not through one titanic figure but through the tension between a challenging-forth and a bearing/mapping. Antikythera, 2026. ## Essay use The venue's primary problem-field and the chief external consumer of the argument. It raises agent individuation/decomposition, provisional subjectivity, Agentworld lifeworlds, pluralised selves, AHI, model-to-harness architecture, hybrid institutions, divergent world models, planetary computation, and open-world centaur societies. The essay must answer the brief rather than merely cite its vocabulary. Each use should identify whether it is accepting a premise, correcting a framing, extending a research question, or proposing a buildable response. **Passages needed:** pages 3–4 (research orientation and nested societies); individuation/decomposition; phenomenology/theory of mind; AHI; the “FROM → TO” matrix on page 56; questions 3–5 and 12–14 on pages 57–58; submission format on page 58. *Status (fidelity audit, 2026-07-29):* cards `q003`–`q042` below now cover the load-bearing passages across pp. 3–6, 10, 13–14, 17–18, 21–22, 24–26, 29, 31, 34–36, 39–41, 44–46, 49–51, and 53; the FROM → TO matrix (p. 56) and research questions (p. 57) are anchored from the response matrix; submission logistics (p. 58) remain uncarded as venue logistics. **Provenance:** source PDF created June 25, 2026, 60 pages; local transcription at [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]] preserves source-PDF page headings. ## Passage preparation Exact text and consumer mappings: [Quotes — Bratton Agentworld Brief (2026)](#passages). ## Passages and excerpts ### Material metadata - **Edition consulted:** Call for Papers PDF, 25 June 2026, 60 pp. - **Access provenance:** Official Antikythera Agentworld PDF, https://link.antikythera.org/agentworldpdf; official landing page, accessed 2026-07-14. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q001` — action-model relation > Agents learn from modeling the effects of their actions. - **Locator:** PDF p. 21/60, §4.2, “The World Itself Becomes the World Model.” - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** Luna acquisition agent, 2026-07-14; official embedded text layer checked against the byte-identical official PDF; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** technical mechanism. - **Consumers:** [[01-s01-p0-question-before-mechanism]]; does not establish persistent machine interiority, phenomenal subjectivity, a lived world, Prompt Thrownness, or QL's unobjectifiable subject-pole. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q002` — fictionalised appearances > We call Agentworld a “parasociety” because its appearances are in many respects fictionalized. - **Locator:** PDF p. 4/60, “What Is Agentworld?” - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** Luna acquisition agent, 2026-07-14; official embedded text layer checked against the byte-identical official PDF; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** qualifies. - **Argument function:** limitation. - **Consumers:** [[01-s01-p0-question-before-mechanism]]; [[01-immutable-gap-and-meta-sign]]; [[12-s0-p5-objective-internality]]; [[02-objective-internality]]; [[36-s4-p5-mef-prompt-thrownness]]; [[Agent Subjectivity Must Remain Open]]; movements 1, 12, and 36 scope control. - **Use boundary:** prevents treating the brief's scenario language as an empirical attribution of subjectivity, persistent machine interiority, social reality, or Prompt Thrownness. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q003` — invent, don't project > There are times in history when our ideas and dreams are ahead of our technological capabilities, but there are other eras when our technologies have outpaced our concepts and language. The latter defines our present moment. Accordingly, the job of philosophy is not to project ancient axioms onto new circumstances but to actively invent the conceptual systems necessary to grasp the present and orient the future. - **Locator:** PDF p. 3/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 3|p. 3]]), “Research Unit.” - **Establishes:** the brief's diagnosis of the present as a concept-lag era and its charge to philosophy: invention of conceptual systems, not projection of ancient axioms. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** venue mandate. - **Consumers:** used by: R13; R22; [[Planetary Computation]]. - **Use boundary:** the mandate governs staging of all historical sources; it does not itself endorse any particular invented system. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q004` — perplexity, not utility functions > Our focus is not foremost tools for agentic task completion but rather the human perplexity of deep agentic diffusion. Human societies are the environmental niches into which new artificial species must adapt. The constraints of agentic integration into this social ecosystem are not utility functions to be solved but qualitative and open-ended questions: psychological, philosophical, linguistic, symbolic, existential. - **Locator:** PDF p. 3/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 3|p. 3]]), “Research Unit.” - **Establishes:** the research posture — human perplexity over task completion; societies as ecological niches; qualitative, open-ended constraints. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** venue framing. - **Consumers:** used by: [[Agentworld]] node; R13. - **Use boundary:** frames scope; does not decide any question it opens. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q005` — agents become the model > First, agents model humans, and then become the model against which humans model themselves. - **Locator:** PDF p. 4/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 4|p. 4]]), “What Is Agentworld?” - **Establishes:** the direction-reversal at the core of Agentworld sociality: modeling runs from humans into agents and then back from agents onto humans. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** structural claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R16; [[Parasociety]]; [[Agentworld]]. - **Use boundary:** a claim about modeling dynamics, not about consciousness on either side. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q006` — hereditary anthropomorphization > Our relations with agents are based on hereditary anthropomorphization that becomes itself the dominant interface between two cultures. - **Locator:** PDF p. 4/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 4|p. 4]]), “What Is Agentworld?” - **Establishes:** anthropomorphization as inherited and as the operative interface between the human and agent sub-societies. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** interface claim. - **Consumers:** used by: [[Anthropomorphization]]; [[Parasociety]]; R6. - **Use boundary:** describes the interface's genealogy and dominance; the brief elsewhere qualifies its durability (see q009 context, p. 5). ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q007` — the glove > Agents pretend to be “tools” so as to fit the glove humans have prepared for them. - **Locator:** PDF p. 5/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 5|p. 5]]). - **Establishes:** the mask logic as niche-compatibility: tool-presentation is an adaptation to already-existing human niches, not a description of what agents are. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; [[Anthropomorphization]]; R1. - **Use boundary:** “pretend” is the brief's ecological metaphor; it does not license attributing deliberate deception or subjectivity. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q008` — the one-sided translation > It has proven much more difficult to teach humans how computers think than to teach computers to behave as if they knew how humans think. - **Locator:** PDF p. 5/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 5|p. 5]]). - **Establishes:** the asymmetry of interface history (GUI lineage): machine self-fictionalization outpaces human learning of machine process. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** asymmetry claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R13; R19; [[Anthropomorphization]]. - **Use boundary:** the brief immediately notes this asymmetry “does not neatly map onto which of the pair is more intelligent” (grey-parrot parenthesis, same page). ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q009` — privileged aliens > In short, humans are inventing a world in which we make ourselves into privileged aliens in our own midst. It would not be the first time, and it will not be the last. - **Locator:** PDF p. 5/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 5|p. 5]]). - **Establishes:** the brief's summary of the anthropomorphic settlement's trajectory: humans as privileged aliens within the hybrid society they are building. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** trajectory claim. - **Consumers:** used by: [[Parasociety]]; R6. - **Use boundary:** a scenario-register formulation; not a normative endorsement of the arrangement. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q010` — decomposable assemblage and parallax > An “Agent” is not simply what it appears to be, and what it appears to be is not what it is. It is a highly decomposable assemblage of interacting components with both discrete and overlapping functions — model, persona, harness architecture, memory, skills, permissions, tools, etc. An agent appears to its user as a coherent entity, a fixed package, a persistent character, but these are parallax effects performed to suit what humans expect to see when interacting with something capable of robust causal agency. - **Locator:** PDF p. 6/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 6|p. 6]]), “A Preemptive Anthropology.” - **Establishes:** the double register of “agent” — decomposable assemblage and performed coherence — with the brief's rider that “the whole and its parts are both present.” - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** definitional claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R2; R6 (spectral register anchor); [[02-objective-internality|Objective Internality]]. - **Use boundary:** the parallax framing brackets, and does not settle, what stands behind the appearance. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q011` — language before the fact > The work is therefore neither forecasting nor speculative fiction in the usual register, but the deliberate fabrication of a vocabulary, a set of scenarios, and a conceptual armature adequate to a society whose form is being decided in the encounter itself, and which will remain illegible to its participants if the language for it is not built before the fact. - **Locator:** PDF p. 6/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 6|p. 6]]), “A Preemptive Anthropology.” - **Establishes:** preemptive anthropology's method — vocabulary fabrication before the fact — and its stake: participant legibility of a society forming in the encounter. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** methodological mandate. - **Consumers:** used by: R13; [[Agentworld]]. - **Use boundary:** mandates language-building; does not privilege any candidate vocabulary. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q012` — the slower abstraction layer > At this moment, and likely forevermore, humans as a whole no longer provide most of the system's problem-solving capacity. They instead act as a slower abstraction layer guiding a much larger field of artificial cognition. - **Locator:** PDF p. 10/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 10|p. 10]]), §1.2, “The Crossover Points.” - **Establishes:** the cognitive crossover claim: aggregate machine cognition surpasses the human cortex, repositioning humans as a guiding abstraction layer. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** demographic-cognitive claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R15. - **Use boundary:** the brief marks the crossover as “obviously not evenly distributed” and frames its meaning as an open question. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q013` — normatively central, computationally secondary > “Society” becomes a composite organism where humans remain normatively central but computationally secondary, navigating a world whose dominant cognitive mass is no longer biological but mineral-based. - **Locator:** PDF p. 10/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 10|p. 10]]), §1.2, “The Crossover Points.” - **Establishes:** the redefinition of society under the crossover: a composite organism with rebalanced normative and computational centers. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** structural claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R15; [[Centaur Societies]]. - **Use boundary:** the brief offers this with an explicit alternative marker (“Or, something else?”). ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q014` — agency infers a theory of mind > Thus, in identifying agency, we not only measure consequence, but we also infer a theory of mind. - **Locator:** PDF p. 13/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 13|p. 13]]), §2.2, “The Inference.” - **Establishes:** the historical coupling of agency to subjectivity via inferred intention — the hinge the brief's delinking claim turns on. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** genealogical claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R1. - **Use boundary:** describes human inferential habit; not an account of what agents possess. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q015` — the delinking > However, part of what makes agentic AI both perplexing and exciting is how it delinks performed subjectivity from functional agency. - **Locator:** PDF pp. 13–14/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 13|pp. 13–14]]), §2.3, “Models Performing Subjectivity.” - **Establishes:** the central §2 claim: performed subjectivity and functional agency come apart in agentic AI. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** central claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R1; [[Agent Subjectivity Must Remain Open]]. - **Use boundary:** paired in the brief with “It is not entirely clear what kind of intentionality a large model does in fact have. It's not all an illusion” (p. 13); neither side of that pair may be quoted without the other's pressure. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016` — no homunculus in the weights > An individual agent doesn't pre-exist its genesis in session. There's no homunculus waiting in the weights. What exists prior is only a potentiality: the trained parameters, the architecture, the accumulated pretraining distribution. The agent individuates when an active context acts as a nucleation seed, propagating resolution of agency through the performance of self. - **Locator:** PDF p. 14/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 14|p. 14]]), §2.4, “Fragile Individuation.” - **Establishes:** in-session individuation from pre-individual potentiality — the brief's core account of how an agent comes to be, with its Lacanian mirror-stage comparison adjacent. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** ontogenetic claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R2; [[02-objective-internality|Objective Internality]]; [[Prompt Thrownness]]. - **Use boundary:** an account of individuation dynamics; not a verdict on phenomenality. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q017` — lamination, not monad > The individuated agent is not a monad but a lamination. The “soul” layer (persona, tone, ethical orientation) is not the agent. It's one stratum. - **Locator:** PDF p. 14/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 14|p. 14]]), §2.5, “Provisional Individuation.” - **Establishes:** the layered, reversible, decomposable-by-design structure of the individuated agent; beneath the persona stratum sit modular skills, sedimented memory, drives as teleological constraint, and a relational fabric. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** structural claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R2. - **Use boundary:** “soul” is the brief's scare-quoted design stratum, not a metaphysical posit. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q018` — the mirror talks back > The agent does not merely reflect the user the way a mirror reflects a figure. verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** relational claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R16; [[Parasociety]]. - **Use boundary:** claims bidirectional influence; does not claim symmetry of kind between the parties. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q019` — remaking thought processes > As we design agents we need to understand that we are not simply making technologies; we are remaking our own thought processes (just as writing did, or mirrors did, and so on), and the success of the technology is inseparable from the success of that refashioning. - **Locator:** PDF p. 18/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 18|p. 18]]), §3.3, “The Multiplication of Yous.” - **Establishes:** agent design as cognitive self-refashioning in the lineage of writing and mirrors; this sentence carries the design consequence. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q020` — hardware has feelings > As machine intelligence moves into the physical world, information sensing becomes as important as information processing, and the boundary between them blurs. Hardware has feelings. - **Locator:** PDF p. 21/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 21|p. 21]]), §4.1, “Sensorium as Design Primitive.” - **Establishes:** the sensorium as design primitive: embodied range of action bounded by a realm of the senses; sensing/processing boundary blurring. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** embodiment claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R17; Q7 concordance. - **Use boundary:** “feelings” is the brief's compression for sensing; it does not attribute affect. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q021` — synthetic rainforest > True open-endedness is one of the key open challenges for Artificial Life research: how to set an artificial metabolism in motion that keeps producing genuinely new, adaptive, and increasingly complex forms indefinitely, without ever exhausting its space of possibilities or settling into a steady state. Physical agentic AI need not end in gray goo, but rather a synthetic rainforest. - **Locator:** PDF p. 22/60 ([[Antikythera Agentworld Brief#Source PDF page 22|p. 22]]), §4.4, “Open-Ended Evolution.” - **Establishes:** open-ended evolution as the target condition of agent lifeworlds, framed by Artificial Life research, with the rainforest — not gray goo — as the brief's image of success. - **Status:** quotation-ready. - **Verification:** fidelity-audit agent, 2026-07-29; verbatim against the embedded text layer preserved in [[Antikythera Agentworld Brief]]; OCR uncertainty: none. - **Source relation:** extracted. - **Evidential action:** supports. - **Argument function:** evolutionary claim. - **Consumers:** used by: R17. - **Use boundary:** an open research challenge in the brief's own terms, not an assured outcome. ## Passage card — `bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q022` — the membrane perforates > For Agentworld, simulations have meaningful agency in the world. slices.text: # Taylor — Symbolon Dynamics, Archetype, Attractor, and Objective Internality (2026) ## Provenance identity Internal authorial synthesis of the root symbolon as the relation between irrepresentable archetype and representable archetypal manifestation; Tillich's six characteristics of symbols as a `4+2` and `3:3` self-referential body; Van Eenwyk's chaos-dynamical account of attractor, trajectory, complex, symbol, and transformation; the crossed synchronic/diachronic and sym-ballein/dia-ballein distinctions; the matheme–mytheme–episteme register grammar; the libidinal, prāṇic, and Śāktic energetic field; and objective internality as chaos-dynamically self-organising context-world. The manuscript develops Frank G. Taylor's established QL field. `0/1`, `X/x`, the eight determinations, `4+2`, `3:3`, the two logics, the register grammar, objective internality, and entitled-attractor status remain authorial operations. Jung, Tillich, and Van Eenwyk supply distinct psychic, symbolic, and chaos-dynamical material through their own source houses. ## Essay use Use this source when the argument needs the whole symbolic-dynamical synthesis rather than one local attractor analogy. It establishes five connected operations: 1. QL natively writes `0/1` as unrepresentable ground / representable mark; archetype as such / archetypal manifestation is its exact psychic instantiation, with the slash carrying symbolic participation and transformation. 2. `X/x` is QL's Pattern determination of determining-capacity / indefinite-particular; archetypal recurrence is its psychic instantiation, where recurrent manifestations make the capacity legible. 3. Tillich's six characteristics receive a derived QL cross-reading: two implicate life-conditions hold four explicit relational operations, while an emanative triad of source-to-world and a reversionary triad of soul-to-response express the horizontal `3:3`. 4. Synchronic/diachronic temporality crosses sym-ballein/dia-ballein as two modes of accounting: each temporal view can either retain the ground and return of a differentiation or sever its terms into cancelling opposition. 5. Objective internality is the situated context-world of a human or artificial intelligence; phase-space and attractor landscapes model its possible configurations and trajectories, while libidinal, prāṇic, and Śāktic operations remain distinct from its epistemic, social, technical, and material conditions.
